title: QaReport
description: What the qa command measured on a delivery, a shot's frames or a still, and what Claude's vision review scored. Every check names what it measured and the threshold it was held to.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

generatedAt.description: When the report was written: an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-26T20:00:00.000Z.

checks.description: The automated checks that ran, in the order they ran.

rubric.description: Vision review rounds, one entry per shot per round; empty when no review ran.

passed.description: True when every check is ok and every rubric entry passed.

SubjectKind.description: What was examined: the assembled delivery, one shot's frame sequence, or one still.

CheckId.description: The automated check: dimensions, fps and duration from ffprobe against the plan; black-frames (blackdetect) and frozen-frames (freezedetect); pops (adjacent-frame SSIM below the threshold away from a planned cut); exposure-drift (signalstats YAVG between shots); text-contrast (WCAG ratio behind each text box); loudness and true-peak (ebur128); hero-still-match (SSIM of the approved still against the rendered frame).

path.description: Absolute path of the delivery file, the frames pattern or the still.

shotId.description: The shot id for a shot or still subject; null for a delivery.

Check.description: One automated measurement and its verdict.

ok.description: True when the measurement met its threshold.

measured.description: The measured value in the check's unit, for example 0.9942 for an SSIM; null when the check could not measure (the detail says why).

threshold.description: The limit the measurement was held to, in the same unit, for example 0.98; null for checks that compare against a plan value named in the detail.

unit.description: Unit of measured and threshold, for example "ssim", "LUFS", "dBTP", "frames", "px" or "ratio".

detail.description: One sentence a reviewer can act on, for example "frame 212 differs from frame 211 (SSIM 0.41) with no planned cut there".

frames.description: Frame numbers the check flagged, for example the first frame of each black segment; empty when none.

RubricScores.description: The ten rubric items, each scored 0 (fails), 1 (acceptable) or 2 (strong).

focalPoint.description: The eye finds the subject within a second: 0 to 2.

composition.description: Anchor, headroom and lead room read as intentional: 0 to 2.

lightDirection.description: Light has a direction and a shape: 0 to 2.

materials.description: Surfaces read as their material (roughness variation, shaped speculars): 0 to 2.

depthCues.description: Depth is present through focus, haze, parallax or overlap: 0 to 2.

palette.description: Colours match the look bible: 0 to 2.

nothingDefault.description: No gray void, default font, stock blue or clipped highlight: 0 to 2.

continuity.description: Lens family, light and grade agree with the neighbouring shots: 0 to 2.

artifacts.description: No aliasing, z-fighting, banding or clipped text: 0 to 2.

RubricRound.description: One vision review of one shot in one round.

round.description: Review round, 1 for the first still, up to the retry cap of 3.

faults.description: The faults the reviewer named before deciding; at least three are expected before a pass.

items.description: One fault in plain words, for example "the cap's highlight clips to white".

pass.description: True when the total is 16 or more with no 0 on focalPoint, typography or artifacts.
